policy: Every entry is code that exists only to read or convert names Stave no longer uses, or to replay a rename on another branch. `bun run check:temporary-migrations` fails once package.json reaches removeInVersion; delete the marked blocks, the listed tests and the entry before that release. See AGENTS.md, Temporary Migrations.

migrations.description: Atelier moved from https://atelier.delight-tools.ai to the UI host https://atelier.sdix.io on 2026-10-30; the old host only redirects, which drops the connector's bearer token. Settings rehydration rewrites a saved craneConnector.baseUrl on the old host to the new UI host, persisted with the next settings save. The Atelier connector vault reads a saved pairing on the old host (atelier-connector.v1.json, or the legacy crane-connector.v1.json it imports) as the new UI host and persists it with the next vault write (pairing, job lease or disconnect). Only the host changes; the pairing, secret and leases are kept. At expiry, delete the marked blocks; a profile that skipped these releases, or a vault never written since, keeps the old host and its connector requests fail until the user disconnects and pairs again with the new Atelier URL.

Through 0.29.2 Fleet View opened on workspace cards and every profile saved fleetBoardLayout: cards, so a saved cards cannot tell a choice from the old default. After 0.29.2 the Tree layout is the default. Settings rehydration moves a saved cards (or a profile saved without the key) to tree once, keeps table, and writes the fleetTreeDefaultApplied marker so a later choice of Cards is kept; it runs only while the marker is absent. At expiry, delete the marked blocks; a profile that skipped these releases keeps its saved cards, and the leftover marker key is ignored.
